detail.longDescription: Hi # infosec folks 👋 This is DeaconGuard, a free, open-source (MIT) security scanner you host yourself. One dashboard shows what's vulnerable, misconfigured or compromised across your Linux servers, Docker hosts, container images, registries and Kubernetes clusters. Code: https:// github.com/Cloudopsshell/deaco nguard Docs: https:// docs.deaconguard.io Feedback very welcome. # introduction # opensource # selfhosted # linux # kubernetes
